evidence: At matched Gaussian count, coupled SDF total-gradient achieved Chamfer 0.07023 and normal consistency 0.71487, versus no-field split-3e5 at 0.07293 and 0.57448. Image-only adaptive gradients removed too much useful split guidance.
goal: Measure how much implicit-field gradient should participate in adaptive split statistics while preserving the full optimization loss.

variants.sdf_total_control: legacy total adaptive gradient, implicit-field fraction 1.0
variants.sdf_base_control: image plus ordinary regularizers, implicit-field fraction 0.0
variants.sdf_blend_025: base gradient plus 25 percent implicit-field gradient
variants.sdf_blend_050: base gradient plus 50 percent implicit-field gradient
variants.sdf_blend_075: base gradient plus 75 percent implicit-field gradient
variants.sdf_base_split_3e5: zero implicit-field split gradient with lower threshold for count matching

fixed: Complete K4 preset, 240 training views, seed 42, 12k, four stages, all other settings unchanged.
parallel_policy: Exactly six variants, all six submitted concurrently on the 12GB GPU.
robustness_policy: Incomplete K5-test3 and K9-test7 manifests are used only after all six training runs complete.
